# nemau_images (Data Source)

The bootable images available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nemau_images" "ubuntu" {
  name = "ubuntu-24.04"
}

# one() fails when the name matches no image or several.
output "ubuntu_image_id" {
  value = one(data.nemau_images.ubuntu.images).id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Keep only the images whose name matches this value exactly.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) The matching images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `disk_format` (String) Disk format of the image.
- `id` (String) Image id, the value `image_id` takes.
- `name` (String) Image name.
- `os_name` (String) Operating system of the image.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by the platform.
